decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The primary use of the premises shall be as a restaurant or caf?, for the sale of food for consumption on the premises in accordance with Class A3 'Restaurants and Cafes' of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1987 (As Amended 2005).

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding any information which may have been  submitted as part of the application, full details of the means of extraction of fumes and odours from the premises, i.e. a full technical specification of the equipment to be used including appropriate sound attenuation measures to be employed, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  The details shall, as a minimum, comprise a three-stage filtration system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter, the ducting shall be isolated from the building structure, the fan unit shall be mounted on anti-vibrational mountings, fan silencers shall be incorporated, and acute bends in the ducting shall be minimised. The filtration system which is subsequently approved shall be implemented on the first bringing into use of the restaurant and shall thereafter be maintained.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers on any day outside the following times - 11am to 11pm.
Condition : 5 - No amplified music shall be played on the premises between 11pm and 8am on any day.
Condition : 6 - The access ramp as shown on the submitted drawings shall be provided on the first bringing into use of the restaurant and shall thereafter be retained.
Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be taken at the site outside the hours of 7am to 9pm on any day.

Condition : 8 - Full details of the alterations to the shopfront, including the materials to be used, and information on the roller shutter box to indicate whether it is to be a manual or electrically operated shutter system, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. The details which are approved shall be implemented on the first bringing into use of the restaurant and shall be retained only as approved.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the information contained within the application concerning the 'bin area', full details of arrangements for the storing of refuse/ waste on the premises, to include measures for the recycling of waste materials, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is brought into use.  The measures which are approved shall be implemented only as approved and thereafter shall be retained.

Condition : 10 - Restaurant operators are required to register with the Council as a food business and to comply with the Food Safety (General Food Hygiene) Regulations 1995 and the Food Safety Act 1990.
Any planning approval will not prejudice any action the Council may be required to take under Part 3 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 should a statutory nuisance be established from the operation of a restaurant.
description: Change of use from A1 (Shops) to A3 (Restaurant) together with provision of external flue on side elevation of premises and alterations to shopfront to include entrance set back with ramp, and roller shutter box.
